figures.evidence: 2 state machines, 19 of 32 words (13 left), 0 DMA, 0 PWM and the GPIO list agree. The bound 'clk_sys at least 75 MHz for 5 MHz a channel at 40/60 duty (6 cycles in 80 ns)' fails in P2's own model under the stated 3 ns jitter: at 75 MHz, 32 ns A-to-B spacing, 40 % and 60 % duty do not decode (75 MHz false/false; 76 MHz false at 40 %); 77 MHz and above decode.
